messages:
Claire Jensen: Dropping a new proposal for the latency/heatmap card. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/latency-ux-compact

Overview:
- Keep p95 as a left-aligned metric with units; move a tiny throughput spark above the heatmap.
- Move sampling into the timepicker row as a compact control: label 'Sampling' + a 3-option segmented control (Off / 10% / Custom).
- Custom opens an inline popover with a slider + numeric input. When sampling != Off, show a subtle pill: 'Sampled • 10%'.
- If sample <5% show an orange low-confidence dot in the pill and add an inline note: 'Low confidence'.
- Keyboard: Tab order -> presets -> sampling -> calendar -> apply. 'C' focuses Custom when pill is active.
- Tooltip microcopy candidate: 'Sampled: results are approximate when sampling is enabled.'

Quick asks: pill wording, segmented control vs dropdown, keyboard affordance, and small-screen collapse behavior.

Omar Ruiz: I like the compact approach. A few notes:
- Segmented control reads faster than a dropdown in this flow.
- Please expose the exact percent as plain DOM text next to the pill so it's copyable for tickets.
- For telemetry add sampling_percent and sampling_mode to query metadata.
- Small screens: collapse sparkline and tuck the pill into the kebab menu; but keep an accessibility-visible help region in DOM.

Navya Mehta: Accessibility bits:
- Segmented control must be a real radiogroup with aria-checked states and roving tabindex.
- Popover slider should have aria-valuetext like 'Sampling rate 10 percent' and a visible numeric readout in DOM.
- Pill must have aria-describedby that points to a persistent help node (not hover-only). Example help text: 'Sampled view shows a subset of requests; numbers are approximate.'
- Keyboard: allow Left/Right to change segmented options; Enter to open Custom. Document 'C' shortcut carefully (avoid conflicts).

Benario Cruz: Product/infra notes:
- If p95 is computed from sampled data, prefix with an asterisk '*' and show 'estimated' in the help region.
- We'll log sampling_percent per query for reproducibility. Add a flag in staging to force 100% for investigations.
- Low-confidence state when percent <5% should appear in telemetry as sampling_confidence: 'low'.

a11y-bot: Checklist added to ticket INFR-5099:
- [ ] Segmented control implemented as accessible radiogroup
- [ ] Popover slider exposes aria-valuetext + numeric input
- [ ] Pill has aria-describedby to persistent help text in DOM
- [ ] Exact sampling percent rendered as copyable text
- [ ] p95 shows '*' when estimated from a sample
- [ ] Telemetry: sampling_percent, sampling_mode, sampling_confidence

Claire Jensen: Thanks! I'll update the Figma with the segmented control + popover and add two microcopy variants for the pill tooltip:
A) 'Sampled: results are approximate when sampling is enabled.'
B) 'Sampled: only a subset of requests are shown; numbers may vary.'

Which is clearer for non-technical PMs? Also scheduling a 20m playtest Fri 8:30am PT to validate keyboard flow and small-width collapse. Invite: @Navya Mehta @Omar Ruiz @Benario Cruz.

Omar Ruiz: Prefer A (shorter). I'll join and validate telemetry hooks.

Navya Mehta: I'll run the a11y pass during the playtest and check screen reader announcements.

Benario Cruz: I'll coordinate staging flag and ensure logs include sampling_percent. See you Fri.

Claire Jensen: Awesome — will post playtest notes and update ticket INFR-5099 after the session. :sparkles:
